title: Dubbii Rocks!
body: Absolutely loving my new Dubbii app- just done first session clearing my coffee table today thats been bugging me for weeks♥️👏but also so much more than that - I felt such compassionate grief for myself first for all the years I have judged myself for not being able to just get on with all of these tasks or support myself to exercise regularly etc, and the lack of self trust this has engendered… this app is life-changing 🥰🥳👍
author: lil chk’n

title: Achieve your dreams.
body:
It is no understatement to say that dubbii’s body doubling team help you achieve your dreams.
The watch anytime videos can help you break steps down and get tasks done. The reminders are gentle and genuinely helpful - and don’t rely on the stress of streaks, because when you lose a streak you lose the motivation for that streak. The live body doubling sessions remind you that you are not alone, there are others who all root for you to achieve your goals today. Is your goal admin? dubbii can help. Is it cleaning? dubbii can help. Is it hygiene? dubbii can help. Is it cooking? dubbii can help. Is it taking the time to do something for yourself like make a craft or build a lego set or whatever takes your fancy? dubbii. Can. Help.
I paid for a year after watching one preview video. This is my one and only subscription. I have no Netflix, no Spotify. I pay for dubbii because it is life-changing.
author: Amemait
